subject.title: [Feature]: Inbound media shared across all agents — no per-agent isolation

question: What should the durable inbound-media isolation boundary be across agents and channels for this issue?
rationale: The source-backed gap is real, but choosing account, agent/session, tenant, channel/chat provenance, and explicit-sharing semantics sets a security and compatibility contract that automation should not invent.

options.title: Define scoped contract first
options.body: Choose the scope identity, compatibility behavior, and explicit sharing semantics before implementation changes storage and staging paths.

options.title: Limit to account scoping
options.body: Implement the lower-friction account-based directory model and accept that non-1:1 account-to-agent and tenant-sharing cases will need follow-up.

options.title: Split by narrower trackers
options.body: Keep this issue as design context while only channel-specific slices like Feishu or provenance namespacing move independently.

recommendation.title: Define scoped contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the scope identity, compatibility behavior, and explicit sharing semantics before implementation changes storage and staging paths.
